WARRANTY INQUIRY

Window film and paint protection film

Enter one of: your warranty number (SZ-…), the 17-character VIN of your vehicle, or the mobile number you gave your installer.

Description
Window film warranty
  • Covers confirmed product defects under normal use, such as abnormal discoloration, delamination or bubbling caused by the film.
  • Covers installation issues such as trapped contamination, poor trimming or edge lifting caused by the work.
  • Film and installation coverage are assessed and timed separately for each product model.
Paint protection film (body cover) warranty
  • Adhesion without abnormal delamination, blistering or separation from the covered panels.
  • No abnormal yellowing or loss of clarity caused by the product.
  • Professional removal without damage to sound, original factory paint.
  • Installation issues on the covered panels, assessed against the installation instructions.
What is usually not covered
  • Collision, impact, scratches, stone chips through the film or vandalism.
  • Unsuitable chemicals or cleaning against the care instructions.
  • Repainted, previously damaged or non-original paint.
  • Later modifications, abnormal use, or glass and vehicle defects not caused by the film.
  • Removal of the film by someone other than an approved installer.
Care after installation
  • Follow the curing time your installer gives you before washing or, for window film, lowering the windows.
  • Use mild, pH-neutral cleaners and soft cloths, and keep pressure washers away from film edges.
  • Clean off bird droppings, tree sap, tar and fuel promptly.
  • If you notice lifting, bubbles or shrinkage, contact your installer with photos and your warranty number.
About your warranty
  • The warranty is issued to the original customer and becomes active after Solarzed verifies the product and installation.
  • Every claim is assessed on its cause and evidence. Statutory consumer rights always apply.
  • Read the full warranty guide or contact support.
